items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions Pete Brown was in John Kirby's band; Interviewee confirms details about the band but does not claim personal interaction with Pete Brown.

ctx.x: Yeah. That's how John Kirby got his style. I was at the Famous Door next door and at that time John Kirby had five pieces and five of the loudest guys you ever heard in your life.
He had Pete Brown on saxophone-- And Frankie Newton.
